- Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM. Both lanes were working as of 11:07 AM.
- Your status-page access issue is tracked under INC-4821. We are still working on it.

Carrowmere Cloud is checking the Hartford gateway route. Let me know if anything is still off on your side.

Best,
Gideon
